claims.evidence: Role swaps, order changes and edge rewiring are detectable; controls without the relevant operator remain invariant.
claims.boundary: Controlled illustrations and ablations support the designed representation, not arbitrary graph reasoning.

claims.evidence: All 9,000 retrieved top hits resolve to source records and reconstruct their float32 reference scores.
claims.boundary: Provenance is retained alongside vectors; arithmetic contributions include interference and do not establish causes. Float16 search has a separately recorded quantization residual.

claims.evidence: Frozen encoder, delayed reviews, additive class memories, exact reversal; HDC reaches mean macro F1 ≥0.80 with 1 review per class (4 total).
claims.boundary: Supervised learning still requires labels. Updates can regress, and the scenarios are simulated.

claims.evidence: Addition, prediction and review incorporation are measured separately on CPU against trained LR and MLP.
claims.boundary: Fast addition alone is not serving latency, energy efficiency, or an advantage over the measured controls.

claims.evidence: 16,384 bytes per raw hypervector versus 84 bytes per LR/MLP input vector.
claims.boundary: This study shows no storage saving from HDC.
